# Telegram Mini App SDK

Unmodified official distribution fetched from https://telegram.org/js/telegram-web-app.js on 2026-10-18.

File: `telegram-web-app-20261018.js`
SHA-256: `124bdff7ba3fe86c8ba5143467afec21e020405e74abdb92cfdda6c0ee3b5908`

Hosted on the same origin so staff do not need a separate browser connection to telegram.org. Only the team panel loads it. Telegram-signed initData is still verified by the backend; this does not replace authentication. Refresh deliberately when Telegram compatibility requires it, using a new dated filename.
